# Akshat Mandloi

Co-Founder \| Smallest.ai

Agent BuildingCompanyComparisonFeaturesIndustriesResearch

Akshat Mandloi is the co-founder and CTO of Smallest AI, where he leads the research and engineering behind the company's voice models. An IIT Guwahati graduate and former senior data scientist, he drives the work on Lightning TTS, Pulse STT, and low-latency voice infrastructure.
